rationale: Justice Thomas is best positioned to assign and likely to keep the majority together around a text-based comparability requirement (no “magic words,” but nonconclusory like-for-like facts are essential) while affirming dismissal. The dissent is most likely to be led by Justice Kagan (possibly with a separate Roberts writing) emphasizing Hughes/Dudenhoeffer’s context-sensitive pleading and resisting a de facto benchmark prerequisite.
